## Brontotherium (CR 8)

**XP** 4,800  
 N Huge animal  
 **Init** +4; **Senses** low-light vision, scent; Perception +20  

**Defense**

 **AC** 17, touch 8, flat-footed 17 (+9 natural, –2 size)  
 **hp** 115 (11d8+55 plus 11)  
 **Fort** +14, **Ref** +7, **Will** +6  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 40 ft.  
 **Melee** gore +16 (2d6+13)  
 **Space** 15 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft.  
 **Special Attacks** powerful charge (gore, 4d8+24), trample (1d8+13, DC 24)  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 29, **Dex** 10, **Con** 21, **Int** 2, **Wis** 13, **Cha** 2  
 **Base Atk** +8; **CMB** +19; **CMD** 29 (33 vs. trip)  
 **Feats** [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), Great Fortitude, Iron Will, Skill Focus (Perception), [Weapon Focus (gore)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md), [Improved Initiative](../../rules/feats/improved-initiative.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Endurance and Toughness are one feat, Toughness; Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (gore), Improved Initiative.*  
 **Skills** Perception +20, Swim +13  

  

  
  
  **Source**
  Wikipedia
  
  

**Ecology**

 **Environment** temperate forests and plains  
 **Organization** solitary or herd (2–8)  
 **Treasure** none
